title: Navigation Model — Session & Question Deep Linking
purpose: Defines the bidirectional linking model between questions, sessions, and recommendations. Every entity becomes navigable — click a question to see its sessions, click a session to see its questions, click a recommendation to launch its assigned session. This closes the gap between findings and execution.

relationships.Question → Sessions: A question is referenced by zero or more sessions. Sessions are discovered via registry cross-reference and recommendation linkage.
relationships.Session → Questions: A session operates on zero or more questions. Questions are listed in session deliverables and recommendation records.
relationships.Recommendation → Question: A recommendation targets zero or more questions. Questions are linked via LinkedQuestions array.
relationships.Recommendation → Session: A recommendation is assigned to a target session. Session is linked via TargetSession field.
relationships.Session → Recommendations: A session may contain zero or more recommendations (source or target). Recommendations are discovered via registry scan.
relationships.Question → Recommendations: A question may be referenced by zero or more recommendations. Recommendations discovered via getByQuestion().
relationships.Report → Session: A report is produced by exactly one session.

question_deep_linking.description: Every question reference in the platform is navigable. A question link provides access to all related context.
question_deep_linking.compound_key_resolution: All question links resolve via compound-key identity (QID + CC + EW_Pattern + Template_Family + File_Path + VersionID). QID-only is insufficient for template-rotation items.

available_actions.open_question: Navigate to question viewer showing: Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice (masked/highlighted based on mode), ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong[A-D], all metadata fields, governance state.
available_actions.view_history: Show all DELTA_LEDGER entries for this identity_key. Version chain with dates and change types.
available_actions.view_certification_state: Show current question_state, quality scores across 10 CAQS dimensions, last certification date, certification batch.
available_actions.view_recommendations: List all recommendations linked to this question. Each entry shows: RecommendationId, Status, Priority, SourceSession, Description.
available_actions.view_sessions: List all sessions that referenced this question. Each entry shows: SessionId, Role (source of finding, target of remediation, verified by), Date.

session_linking.description: Every session exposes: its findings, deliverables, linked questions, linked recommendations, and produced reports. Sessions become navigable hubs for certification workflow.

available_actions.open_session: Navigate to session summary showing: SessionId, Date, Type, Status, Pre-flight checklist results, Readiness distribution.
available_actions.view_findings: List all defects or issues discovered by this session. Each finding shows: FindingType, Severity, QuestionIDs, Status.
available_actions.view_deliverables: List all files produced by this session (reports, specs, registry entries).
available_actions.view_questions: List all questions referenced by this session. Each entry links via compound-key deep link.
available_actions.view_recommendations: List all recommendations created by or assigned to this session.
available_actions.view_reports: List all report files generated. Link to each file.

example_view.type: DL-026 Remediation — Pack C Section E
example_view.status: Complete — 3 items remediated, 0 DL-026 remaining in Section E

recommendation_linking.description: A recommendation is the bridge between finding and execution. Every recommendation provides direct access to launch work.

available_actions.open_recommendation: View full recommendation: ID, Status, Priority, Description, LinkedQuestions, TargetSession, Owner, CreatedDate, ClosureEvidence.
available_actions.open_assigned_session: Navigate to the session assigned to execute this recommendation.
available_actions.view_linked_questions: List all linked questions with deep links.
available_actions.verify_closure: Check ClosureEvidence file exists and is valid.

navigation_registry_schema.description: Stores all entity relationships for O(1) cross-referencing. Rebuilt at session T0 from CANONICAL_REGISTRY, RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY, and SESSION_REGISTRY.
